exposure: SMFM diagnostic criteria for AFE (sudden cardiac arrest or both respiratory and hemodynamic collapse, biological disseminated intravascular coagulopathy, absence of fever, clinical onset during labor or within 30 min of delivery)
clinical presentation of women with strong suspicion of AFE
outcome: validity of SMFM diagnostic criteria for AFE
cohort: The cohort consisted of 14 women with a strong suspicion of Amniotic Fluid Embolism (AFE) out of 54,140 women who delivered at the Port Royal maternity unit in Paris between 2006 and 2018.
finding: Only 43% of women with a strong suspicion of Amniotic Fluid Embolism (AFE) met all four SMFM diagnostic criteria, suggesting these criteria may not fully capture the clinical presentation of AFE.
